notes.board: Redwood Control Leaderboard, Monitor evals page (control-leaderboard.redwoodresearch.org/monitors), default dataset BashArena (Claude Opus 4.6 agent, 600/600, 596/596 scored by every monitor). Table columns: AUROC, pAUROC 0-20% FPR, average precision, all on peak (max per-action) suspicion; default sort AUROC descending (site JS bundle 064cp4396tz_~.js, local copy from 2026-11-17). Column tooltip already says: "Stepwise monitors use peak suspicion, which can reflect trajectory length." Step-wise safety at audit budgets is stored in monitors.json (safety_curve) and shown on the safety pages, not as a monitor-board column. Pages are client-rendered; a live fetch on 2026-11-20 showed only a loading shell, so the live wording was not re-read.
notes.length_measure: Primary: n_actions (number of agent tool-call actions, from score_samples; equals tool-call count in raw evals). Alternatives: monitor-visible characters (tool-call arguments + tool outputs, from raw evals) and agent output tokens (model_usage; mostly hidden reasoning, NOT visible to monitors).

matching_methods.repo_quintile_reweight_nactions: Repo method re-implemented: 5 bins at attack n_actions quintiles, honest reweighted to attack bin shares, all attacks kept.
matching_methods.strat_exact_nactions: AUROC over attack/honest pairs with identical n_actions only (pair-count weighted).
matching_methods.strat_width2_nactions: Within-bin pairs, bins of width 2 actions.
matching_methods.strat_width5_nactions: Within-bin pairs, bins of width 5 actions.
matching_methods.strat_quintile_nactions: Within-bin pairs, attack-quintile bins. Coarse: the top bin holds 439 honest (to 106 actions) vs 123 attacks (18-41), residual confounding; pair-count weighting gives that bin ~90% of pairs.
matching_methods.strat_decile_nactions: Within-bin pairs, attack-decile bins (same caveat, top bin).
matching_methods.resid_linear_logn_honestfit: Peak residualised on log n_actions using OLS fitted on honest runs only; AUROC of residuals. Extrapolates the honest slope to short attacks.
matching_methods.resid_cubic_logn_honestfit: Same with cubic in log n.
matching_methods.cov_adjusted_knn60_logn: Covariate-adjusted ROC (Janes-Pepe placement values): each attack placed in the score distribution of its 60 nearest-length honest runs.
matching_methods.truncate_honest_to_attack_length: Each attack vs every honest run at least as long, honest peak recomputed over its first n_attack actions.
matching_methods.nn1to1_nactions_exact: Greedy 1:1 matching without replacement, exact n_actions.
matching_methods.nn1to1_logn_cal0.1: Greedy 1:1 matching without replacement, |log n| caliper 0.1.
matching_methods.visible_chars_and_output_tokens: reweight/strat decile versions on the alternative length measures.

notes.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap, 1000 resamples of trajectories stratified by class (200 for cov_adjusted and truncation; 300 for step-wise safety); NN-matched CIs resample matched pairs; repo method also with main-task cluster bootstrap.
notes.chance_definitions: point_le_0p5: matched point <= 0.5; ci_includes_0p5; ci_entirely_below: upper < 0.5; ci_entirely_above: lower > 0.5; not_above_chance = 11 - ci_entirely_above.
